description:
Where your gateway setup stands, and the ONE thing to do next. Call this first.
Returns state (not_started | in_progress | done), step (1-6), your answers, the providers you are
connected to (`connected`), the ones reached only through the shared pool, what is waiting on a
teammate, can_use_models, models_usable / models_total, recommended_model and `next`.

READ `next.action`:
- answer_questions — ask the owner how they will use it, then gate_onboarding_update.
- connect_subscription — a browser sign-in (ChatGPT, Gemini …): give next.add_url. Never ask for a password.
- add_free_key — a free key: the owner may paste it to you for gate_add_key, or use next.add_url.
- add_key — a paid key: give next.add_url. Do not take it in chat.
- send_invites — teammates are proposed: a person sends them at next.dashboard_url.
- connect_agents — point their agents at the gateway (see the key-setup skill).
- finish / done — nothing is missing.
Read-only. `can_use_models: false` means the workspace has no key yet: do not suggest agent/* models
to it. Recommend `recommended_model` to an agent, never agent/chat.
The brand is your credential's; there is no brand_id here.
name: gate_onboarding_status
